## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Running the command with a stubbed browser context that already holds the...

The system SHALL ensure that running the command with a stubbed browser context that already holds the cookies validates them and patches OpenBao within one invocation, with no cookie value on stdout or in logs.

#### Scenario: Running the command with a stubbed browser context that already holds the...

WHEN `add-aca-auth-session-capture-command` is implemented
THEN Running the command with a stubbed browser context that already holds the cookies validates them and patches OpenBao within one invocation, with no cookie value on stdout or in logs.

### Requirement: Running it against a context that never produces the cookies exits non-zero...

The system SHALL ensure that running it against a context that never produces the cookies exits non-zero with a timeout message after the configured wait.

#### Scenario: Running it against a context that never produces the cookies exits non-zero...

WHEN `add-aca-auth-session-capture-command` is implemented
THEN Running it against a context that never produces the cookies exits non-zero with a timeout message after the configured wait.

### Requirement: A second run reuses the persisted profile directory and needs no interactive...

The system SHALL ensure that a second run reuses the persisted profile directory and needs no interactive login when the session is still valid.

#### Scenario: A second run reuses the persisted profile directory and needs no interactive...

WHEN `add-aca-auth-session-capture-command` is implemented
THEN A second run reuses the persisted profile directory and needs no interactive login when the session is still valid.

### Requirement: No refresh timer, cron entry, or scheduled job is created by the command

The system SHALL ensure that no refresh timer, cron entry, or scheduled job is created by the command.

#### Scenario: No refresh timer, cron entry, or scheduled job is created by the command

WHEN `add-aca-auth-session-capture-command` is implemented
THEN No refresh timer, cron entry, or scheduled job is created by the command.

### Requirement: docs/SETUP.md replaces the manual DevTools instructions for Substack with...

The system SHALL ensure that docs/SETUP.md replaces the manual DevTools instructions for Substack with the command.

#### Scenario: docs/SETUP.md replaces the manual DevTools instructions for Substack with...

WHEN `add-aca-auth-session-capture-command` is implemented
THEN docs/SETUP.md replaces the manual DevTools instructions for Substack with the command.
